title: config.set
description: Set settings in the local config, the file the command-line tools read too. The change is checked as a run would check it and written only if it passes; with dry_run it is checked and nothing is written. moves names the cache keys the change moves (detection: re-detect, censor: re-render, encode: re-encode), worked out from the keys themselves. may_move names the keys it can move for some files only, by changing which structure profile (and so which sample rate) or which preview slice a file gets. A value inside one that is set whole (a censor style, a rule list) answers config.not_settable; a change that would fail validation config.invalid, listing each problem. when: after_jobs, while a job holds the queue, checks the change now and keeps it to be written when the queue is idle (answer: when after_jobs, written false, and the waiting change's id; config.applied or config.pending_failed says how it went); with nothing running it is written at once (when now).
